reports.notes: Handwritten fax sent from a realty office (header 'JUN/15/2010/TUE 05:22 PM  Century 21 All Pros  FAX No.801-756-7672'). The Political Party cell is a fast scrawl read as 'Democratic' (the -ic ending, not 'Democrat') at medium confidence. The Office Seeking line is heavy, overlapping handwriting read as 'Utah County Commission Seat B.' at medium confidence; the seat letter B is legible and agrees with index.csv. Lines 3 and 7 are drawn as an open circle - the filer's zero glyph - transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. Most cents on the summary page are superscripted ('519 48'). The Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes on the summary page were all left blank by the filer.
